name: metis-development-tool

scripts.test: npm run test -w @genoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @genoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @genoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @genoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @genoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @genoffice/pipelines && npm run test -w @mdt/schema && npm run test -w @mdt/project
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pipelines && npm run typecheck -w @mdt/schema && npm run typecheck -w @mdt/project && npm run typecheck -w @mdt/generator && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-ops
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:mdt && npm run dist:win -w @mdt/app
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:mdt && npm run dist:mac -w @mdt/app
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:mdt && npm run dist:linux -w @mdt/app
